core.name: Normal Move
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
core.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

core.name: Run
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
core.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

core.name: Retreat
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
core.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit's combat range.

core.name: Shoot
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit's attacks (see 16.0).
core.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

core.name: Charge
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
core.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

core.name: Fight
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit's attacks (see 16.0).
core.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

core.name: Ward Save
core.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit's damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit's ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

core.name: Guarded Hero
effect: If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:

list: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

core.name: Sacred Rites
core.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
core.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST's ritual points to 0.

core.name: Unbind
core.effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.
core.usedBy: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.

core.name: Banish Manifestation
core.effect: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
core.usedBy: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

core.name: Champion
core.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit's Companion weapons

core.name: Standard Bearer
core.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit's control score.

core.name: Musician
core.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the 'Rally' command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

commands.name: Rally
commands.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
effect: Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:

list: For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.

effect: You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

commands.name: Magical Intervention
commands.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
commands.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

commands.name: Redeploy
commands.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
commands.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

commands.name: At the Double
commands.effect: Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit's Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.
commands.usedBy: The unit using that RUN ability.

commands.name: Covering Fire
commands.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
commands.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

commands.name: Counter Charge
commands.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
commands.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

commands.name: Forward to Victory
commands.declare: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
commands.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll.

commands.name: All-Out Attack
commands.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.
commands.usedBy: The unit using that ATTACK ability.

commands.name: All-Out Defence
commands.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.
commands.usedBy: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.

commands.name: Power Through
commands.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
commands.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.
